project_name.justification: The title of the press release is 'Mosaic Signs Letter of Intent to Sell Up to 100% Interest in the Lichen Project'.

company_name.justification: The press release is issued by 'Mosaic Minerals Corporation (CSE: MOC) (“Mosaic” or “The Company”)'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies M. Jonathan Hamel as the President & CEO of Mosaic Minerals Corporation, the seller, not the buyer (Castlebar Capital Corp).

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction allows for the acquisition of up to 100% interest through two options: 'Castlebar may acquire up to a 50% undivided interest (the “First Option”)... exercise an additional option (“Additional Option”) to acquire an additional 50% interest in the Property'.

primary_commodity.justification: The property is described in the context of significant gold projects: 'The volcanic belt is parallel to two known gold bearing volcanic belt, the Bachelor Lake gold area to the west and the Osisko-Windfall gold area to the south. The Nelligan Gold project and The Monster Lake Gold project are located at the eastern extremity of the volcanic belt.'

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable article link was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The transaction involves two Canadian companies (Mosaic Minerals Corp. listed on CSE and Castlebar Capital Corp. on TSX-V) and uses the '$' symbol for payments, implying Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of the First Option's '$205,000' and the Additional Option's '$150,000'. Text states: 'make aggregate cash payments of $205,000 to Mosaic' and 'exercise an additional option (“Additional Option”) to acquire an additional 50% interest in the Property by making a $150,000 cash payment'.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction involves the issuance of shares, but no equivalent cash value for these shares is provided.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are listed as separate components, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares is the sum of 1,350,000 from the First Option and 1,500,000 from the Additional Option. Text states: 'by issuing an aggregate of 1,350,000 shares to Mosaic' and 'issuing 1,500,000 shares to Mosaic within the forty-five (45) day period'.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any stock option payments as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The text specifies the number of shares to be issued by the buyer (Castlebar Capital Corp) but does not state a price per share for the transaction. The detailed quote provided is for the seller (Mosaic Minerals), not the buyer.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The terms require 'by incurring at least $750,000 in qualifying expenditures on the Property'.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the deal for Castlebar to earn 100%, Mosaic will retain a royalty: '...except for a 2% net smelter royalty to be retained by Mosaic.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Lichen Project consists of 282 claims covering a total area of 15,622 hectares.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Lichen Project consists of 282 claims covering a total area of 15,622 hectares.

resource_size.justification: The text describes the regional geology and mentions 'Numerous gold and copper showings' but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate for the Lichen project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The text identifies the acquiring company as 'Castlebar Capital Corp (TSX-V: CBAR.P) (“Castlebar”)'.
